g.text: 60 synthetic cases × 5 methods × 3 repeats; case-level bootstrap intervals. In b, dot area counts overlapping cases; lines pair the same case.
Success checks structured labels, amounts and references only; free text was not independently reviewed. Failures remain in the denominator.
